name: AssertBench
description: AssertBench measures an LLM's resistance to user-induced factual bias by evaluating its ability to maintain factual agreement despite contradictory user framing prompts. It uses evidence-supported facts from FEVEROUS and compares model agreement under different framing conditions.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited adoption so far, mainly of interest for studying factual bias and prompt framing robustness in LLMs.
notes: Focuses on isolating framing-induced variability from underlying factual knowledge.
